description: Extract Markdown task checklist items (- [ ] open or - [x] completed) and @owner / bold-owner assignments across all local meeting notes in the vault. Use this for follow-up tracking, standups, and accountability reviews; prefer okf_search_meetings for general topic search or okf_read_note for full meeting context around a task. Read-only and 100% offline. Returns a JSON array of action item objects containing file, line, completed, owner, text, title, and date, or [] when none match.

limit.description: Maximum number of action items to return (clamped between 1 and 200).

owner.description: Case-insensitive substring filter matching the extracted @owner or **Owner**: assignee (e.g. "Alice"). Leave empty to include unassigned and all owners.

status.description: Filter checklist items by completion state: "open" for unchecked (- [ ]), "completed" for checked (- [x]), or "all" for both.

name: okf_list_action_items
title: List Meeting Action Items
